verdict.rationale: Fee transparency is a fair question for an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions pricing pages, attorney fees, USCIS filing fees, or premium processing costs, so there is no evidence the firm separates its own fees from government fees.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest
